verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own docs say native embedding is generally available. They also state that it embeds your text on both writes and queries without you integrating an embedding provider, which removes the need for a separate embedding pipeline. Both sources are brief first-party claims with no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documentation of which built-in models are supported, evidence of configuring external or alternative model providers, detailed usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
